freshness_boundary.permitted_claim: external real-system feasibility and falsification bridge only

source.title: A secondary upstream invasion of round goby in the Great Lakes Basin over fourteen years following a dam removal

biotic_axis_taxon.role: predeclared biotic-state proxy; no claim that association alone proves competition

A.rule: use all four declared abiotic/habitat variables; do not select variables using focal response coefficients
A.world_construction: derive nested site-support envelopes from response-independent site covariates using fixed 25/50/75/90 percent empirical centrality cutoffs after header/schema gate; exact formula must be committed before focal response rows are parsed

B.temporal_rule: construct site B states only from records dated no later than 2018
B.worlds: for q25/q50/q75 baseline cutoffs include both low-permissive and high-permissive orientations plus unrestricted B
B.reason_for_both_orientations: prevents using already-known published association sign to choose the B direction

M.anchor: Wayne Road Dam / downstream invasion origin
variables: river distance from Wayne Road Dam
M.worlds: derive movement-rate levels only from response-independent site river-distance spacing quantiles; add explicit unrestricted-open world
M.barrier_semantics: dam-removal intervention opens the upstream route; no additional unverified barrier world may be inserted after response access

evidence_contract.compatibility_rule: positive-only containment: a world survives only if every calibration positive is allowed by A intersect B intersect M at that record year
evidence_contract.heldout_use: 2019-2025 focal positive records are used only after the world universe and parser are frozen
evidence_contract.heldout_negative_claim: program-level nondetection must not be promoted to biological absence without a separately frozen observation-process contract

external_bridge_endpoints.primary: heldout positive falsification: number and fraction of calibration-surviving worlds eliminated by each newly observed 2019-2025 positive
secondary: whether all calibration survivors agree on site-by-2025 ecological reachability before heldout opening
whether any unanimous negative ecological certificate is falsified by a later positive record
not_primary: claim that nondetection validates predicted absence

gates: Gate0: record/file identity and md5/size verification only
Gate1: README and CSV header/schema only; no response rows
Gate2: response-independent site/covariate registry and exact A/M world construction
Gate3: freeze focal/community parser, B baseline rule, world product, stop rules and output schema
Gate4: open 2012-2018 calibration rows and contract worlds
Gate5: once-only open/use of 2019-2025 heldout focal positives for falsification audit
hard_stops: do not select A variables by published significance
do not choose B orientation from published sign
do not tune M speed levels from round-goby observed invasion speed
do not drop sites because they falsify worlds
do not call this bridge independent or fresh confirmatory evidence
do not use aggregate published effects as a benchmark target
success_definition: successful bridge means the declared real data can instantiate and falsify finite A/B/M worlds under the frozen rules; a favorable biological direction is not required

protocol_amendment.trigger: live Zenodo API metadata checksum comparison
protocol_amendment.correction: replace the mistyped frozen checksum with the live Zenodo metadata checksum
